hydraulic_power_pack_control.name: hydraulic_power_pack_control
hydraulic_power_pack_control.description: Hydraulic Power Unit controller for Imtex PST systems. Controls hydraulic actuator valve actuation with 4x 4-20mA sensor inputs, pressure band control, redundant pump logic, and alarm management.

enable_pump_2_(redundant).title: Enable Pump 2 (Redundant)
enable_pump_2_(redundant).description: Enable redundant Pump 2 with automatic failover

enable_vfd_speed_control.title: Enable VFD Speed Control
enable_vfd_speed_control.description: Enable VFD speed control for motor modulation

pressure_upper_band_(bar).title: Pressure Upper Band (bar)
pressure_upper_band_(bar).description: Upper pressure threshold (bar) to stop pumping. Range 0-500.

pressure_lower_band_(bar).title: Pressure Lower Band (bar)
pressure_lower_band_(bar).description: Lower pressure threshold (bar) to start pumping. Range 0-500.

dp/dt_alarm_threshold_(bar/s).description: Rate of pressure change alarm threshold (bar/s). Critical alarm.

dp/dt_buffer_size.title: dP/dt Buffer Size
dp/dt_buffer_size.description: Number of samples in dP/dt rolling buffer. Range 3-20.

pt_calibration_drift_threshold_(bar).title: PT Calibration Drift Threshold (bar)
pt_calibration_drift_threshold_(bar).description: Maximum allowed difference between PT1 and PT2 readings (bar). Warning.

filter_dp_warning_(bar).description: Filter differential pressure warning threshold (bar). Warning.

filter_dp_fail_(bar).title: Filter DP Fail (bar)

temperature_high_alarm.title: Temperature High Alarm
temperature_high_alarm.description: Temperature high alarm threshold. Critical alarm.

alarm_grace_period_(s).description: Seconds threshold must be sustained before alarm fires

min_inter-alarm_interval_(s).description: Minimum seconds between repeated alarm triggers

pump_start_delay_(s).title: Pump Start Delay (s)
pump_start_delay_(s).description: Delay in seconds before starting pump after command

pump_switchover_delay_(s).title: Pump Switchover Delay (s)
pump_switchover_delay_(s).description: Delay in seconds before backup pump takes over after primary fault
